messages.author: 32505883a6a1017e
messages.subject: error deploying aplication
parts:
Hi,
I`m buidlding my first shinyapps aplication. It runs locally perfect.
This aplications extracts data from a netcdf file and makes a plot.
When I try to execute deployApp() an error happens:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 10538...
Waiting for task: 28899
  building: Processing Bundle Id: 12660
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 12556
  building: Building package: ncdf (1.6.6)
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 28900 error: Unhandled Exception: Error building ncdf (1.6.6). Build exited with non-zero status: 1

My sessionInfo():

R version 3.0.2 (2013-09-25)
Platform: i386-w64-mingw32/i386 (32-bit)

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=Spanish_Spain.1252  LC_CTYPE=C                    
[3] LC_MONETARY=Spanish_Spain.1252 LC_NUMERIC=C                  
[5] LC_TIME=Spanish_Spain.1252    

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
[1] shinyapps_0.3

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] digest_0.6.4   RCurl_1.95-4.1 RJSONIO_1.0-3  tools_3.0.2   


Thanks!

José Manuel Prieto

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] error deploying aplication
parts:
Hi Jose,
We have the day off here today, but I wonder if this is the same issue we have had where ShinyApps doesn't handle foreign characters all that well.

If that is the case, you can usually resolve it by creating a file called: .Renviron to your application directory and add the following line to it.
LANG="C.UTF-8"


If that doesn't work, would you mind sending us the output of the following two calls:

shinyapps::appDependencies()

packageDescription('ncdf')

Thanks for your help Jose,
Tareef

We have the day off here today, but I wonder if this is the same issue we have had where ShinyApps doesn't handle foreign characters all that well.

If that is the case, you can usually resolve it by creating a file called: .Renviron to your application directory and add the following line to it.
LANG="C.UTF-8"


If that doesn't work, would you mind sending us the output of the following two calls:

shinyapps::appDependencies()

packageDescription('ncdf')

Thanks for your help Jose,
Tareef
